article.title: 礼
article.question: 第一次见未来婆婆，送什么礼物呢？
article.brief:
礼者，祭之仪也。

article.text:
礼者，祭之仪也。
“赠送礼物”的本质是一种“祭祀”，如同有人斋戒、沐浴、杀五牲、烧黄表，祭献于天，以求丰登。
礼之重，不在其价，而在其仪。
什么叫“重礼”？不是指它的价值千金，而在于它的郑重其事。
什么叫“郑重其事”？
昏礼。下达。纳采，用雁。主人筵于户西，西上，右几。使者玄端至。摈者出请事，入告。主人如賔服，迎于门外，再拜，賔不答拜。揖入。至于庙门，揖入；三揖，至于阶，三让。主人以賔升，西面。賔升西阶。当阿，东面致命。主人阼阶上北面再拜；授于楹闲，南面。賔降，出。主人降，授老雁。摈者出请。賔执雁，请问名，主人许。賔入，授，如初礼。摈者出请，賔告事毕。入告，出请醴賔。賔礼辞，许。主人彻几，改筵，东上。侧尊甒醴于房中。主人迎賔于庿门外，揖让如初，升。主人北面，再拜，賔西阶上北面答拜。主人拂几授校，拜送。賔以几辟，北面设于坐，左之，西阶上答拜。赞者酌醴，加角柶，面叶，出于房。主人受醴，面枋，筵前西北面。賔拜受醴，复位。主人阼阶上拜送。赞者荐脯醢。賔即筵坐，左执觯，祭脯醢，以柶祭醴三，西阶上北面坐，啐醴，建柶，兴，坐奠觯，遂拜。主人答拜。賔即筵，奠于荐左，降筵，北面坐取脯；主人辞。賔降，授人脯，出。主人送于门外，再拜。《仪礼 · 士昏礼第二》
昏通婚，这就是纳采之礼——也就是男方登女方门提亲的礼仪。
礼物本身已经规定好，根本不是什么贵重之物，重的是这些“繁文缛节”。
施礼的人有规矩，受礼的人也有规矩，郑重其事，在于把守这个规矩视作双方向上天的诚意证明。
因为礼之所以立也，天授圣人以设之。等于上天通过圣贤对施礼之人的一种承诺。你们按照这个既定的程序办，那么你们由此所求的事就自有天佑。
这不是在敬拜对方，而是通过双方的严谨恭敬，取悦设立这规矩的上天。
而通过这种一丝不苟的郑重其事，我知你愿之诚，你知我愿之诚。你我可欺，天不可欺。
所以事成。
我们中国被称为“礼仪之邦”，国教被称为“礼教”，这就是我们的文化根源、祖宗之法，是每一个中国人灵魂深处的文化本能。
你懂得这道理，踩得中这奥秘的要点，你会在中国拥有一种旁人难以想象的影响力。
对别人嬉皮笑脸的，在你面前就不由自主对肃容正色。
你所说的话，必受聆听，
你所请的事，必受重视。
这种感情，甚至不是对方可以自我克制的。
这是中国人的“魔法”。
不用你懂，不用你明白，只要行礼如仪，也一样会让你满腔热血莫名的沸腾，可以披肝沥胆、推心置腹，抛头颅、洒热血，慷慨赴难，鞠躬尽瘁，死而后已。
你是不是觉得这好玄，好像在骗你？
那么试一试回头去看看王家卫的《一代宗师》。
你看不懂，但你却能直接感受到的这些人身上那股“劲力”，不是吗？

这里面有一个不知礼，于是也没有这力，你一见就知道你不会对ta有同样尊敬的人。
你看得出是谁吗？
还有一个知礼不守，你也许会畏ta避ta，但却并不甚敬他的人。
你看得出来是谁吗？

你看得出来，你的血里，你的骨头里就有这东西。
这就是华夏贵胄的印记，是中国人几千年来傲视“蛮夷”的傲气所在。
某种意义上，也是华夏民族垂四千年不死不灭，总会君临天下的最底层的原因。
天佑不佑礼，你猜？

所以，不要把礼物本身的价钱看作送礼的核心。
这不是说礼物就要廉价——不，当然要在适格的前提下有匹配的价值。
但无论它值多少钱，在你所施的这礼面前，这些黄金珠玉，仍然不配提起。
你的诚意本身才是这礼里值钱的东西，黄金珠玉——也就是“礼物”只是这礼里的道具，是装珠子的盒子。
宝珠当然要用锦盒，但谁为锦盒洋洋自得？
可怜这些东西失传太久，不为人知，国人送了多少“好吃的”“好玩的”，以为“重礼”。
其实那不是礼，而是礼之中几个特殊的子类——贡、献、奉、贿、赂。
以臣贡君，以子奉亲，以祭献神。
贿为金钱，赂为财物——这指的是礼物的形式。
本来贿赂并无贬义，只是指以钱财为形式的礼物。但因为钱财的通货属性，受礼者往往可以将这些礼物挪作它用，所以被收买寻租的行为占有了字体罢了。
贡以利君，乃重其好——臣子要给君主进贡最优良的产品，辅助
奉以养亲，乃重其先——吃喝给养，先奉养父母尊亲。
献以敬神，乃重其美——敬拜神灵，要用美物。什么叫美？无瑕疵的羊，为美。这也是为什么“向伟大祖国献礼”要用“献”字。
什么叫做你会说汉语，你不自知就懂？
这些词用错了地方，你本能就知道用错了。

然后你再看你要见男方父母的礼仪。
你是要贡吗？——送自己家出产的好东西，比如自己家是做皮鞋的，送双好皮鞋；或者送对方合用的工具，比如对方是画家，送人笔墨纸砚——就是贡。但对方是你的君主、上司吗？
是要奉吗？——送人参燕窝，送好烟好茶，就是奉——但人家同意你当儿媳了吗？你凭什么奉？
是要献吗？——送世间仅存的奇珍异宝，是为献。但对方是神哲圣贤（这包含对人类做出历史贡献的特殊伟人）吗？ta会觉得受的起吗？
送金送银，是为贿；
送车送房，是为赂。
你是要收买ta们一个是字吗？

看懂没有？送礼的人们？

那这里该要送什么？
你该送“你自己”—— 一件可以超越语言和文字，让对方知道你、了解你的东西。
例如，
一副自己手写的字——诗以咏志，字如其人。
一道自己做的菜——以情入味，以工见意。
一瓶与你为人最近的香——以香载道。
叔叔阿姨，我就是来让你们仔仔细细看看我是谁。
我喜欢什么，我看重什么，我追求什么。我的志向和我的原则。
我把我最珍视、在意的东西凝聚成这东西送给你们，因为我知道你们这时在意的不是我有多少身家、我会对你们有多好，而是在意我和你们的儿子是不是志向相合、意趣相投。
所以我不但回答你们的问提，而且送上这件东西来请你们看、尝、闻。
我虽爱他，但我并不是判断我是不是适合ta的最佳人选，因为我心不静。
他虽爱我，但也一样。
我今天托付给你们判断，相信你们对他的爱与我一样，而你们一定善尽职责。
所以我知无不言，言无不尽，再作这件东西，让你们更能看到言辞之外的我。
你们的决定，比我更好更清醒。
这就是我对你们和他的礼。
我心至诚，可对天地。
一躬到底，听凭尊意。

这不能保证对方一定首肯。
但你会甘心。

这就是礼，记住了。

:1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以，不要把礼物本身的价钱看作送礼的核心。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这不是说礼物就要廉价——不，当然要在适格的前提下有匹配的价值。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但无论它值多少钱，在你所施的这礼面前，这些黄金珠玉，","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"仍然不配提起","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你的诚意本身才是这礼里值钱的东西，黄金珠玉——也就是“礼物”只是这礼里的道具，是装珠子的盒子。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"宝珠当然要用锦盒，但谁为锦盒洋洋自得？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"可怜这些东西失传太久，不为人知，国人送了多少“好吃的”“好玩的”，以为“重礼”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"其实那不是礼，而是礼之中几个特殊的子类——","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"贡、献、奉、贿、赂。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"以臣贡君，以子奉亲，以祭献神。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"贿为金钱，赂为财物——这指的是礼物的形式。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"本来贿赂并无贬义，只是指以钱财为形式的礼物。但因为钱财的通货属性，受礼者往往可以将这些礼物挪作它用，所以被收买寻租的行为占有了字体罢了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"贡以利君，乃重其好——臣子要给君主进贡最优良的产品，辅助","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"奉以养亲，乃重其先——吃喝给养，先奉养父母尊亲。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"献以敬神，乃重其美——敬拜神灵，要用美物。什么叫美？无瑕疵的羊，为美。这也是为什么“向伟大祖国献礼”要用“献”字。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"什么叫做你会说汉语，你不自知就懂？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这些词用错了地方，你本能就知道用错了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"然后你再看你要见男方父母的礼仪。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你是要贡吗？——送自己家出产的好东西，比如自己家是做皮鞋的，送双好皮鞋；或者送对方合用的工具，比如对方是画家，送人笔墨纸砚——就是贡。但对方是你的君主、上司吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是要奉吗？——送人参燕窝，送好烟好茶，就是奉——但人家同意你当儿媳了吗？你凭什么奉？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是要献吗？——送世间仅存的奇珍异宝，是为献。但对方是神哲圣贤（这包含对人类做出历史贡献的特殊伟人）吗？ta会觉得受的起吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"送金送银，是为贿；","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"送车送房，是为赂。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你是要收买ta们一个是字吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"看懂没有？送礼的人们？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那这里该要送什么？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你该送“你自己”—— 一件可以超越语言和文字，让对方知道你、了解你的东西。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"例如，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一副自己手写的字——诗以咏志，字如其人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一道自己做的菜——以情入味，以工见意。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一瓶与你为人最近的香——以香载道。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"叔叔阿姨，我就是来让你们仔仔细细看看我是谁。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我喜欢什么，我看重什么，我追求什么。我的志向和我的原则。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我把我最珍视、在意的东西凝聚成这东西送给你们，因为我知道你们这时在意的不是我有多少身家、我会对你们有多好，而是在意我和你们的儿子是不是志向相合、意趣相投。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以我不但回答你们的问提，而且送上这件东西来请你们看、尝、闻。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我虽爱他，但我并不是判断我是不是适合ta的最佳人选，因为我心不静。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"他虽爱我，但也一样。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我今天托付给你们判断，相信你们对他的爱与我一样，而你们一定善尽职责。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以我知无不言，言无不尽，再作这件东西，让你们更能看到言辞之外的我。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你们的决定，比我更好更清醒。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这就是我对你们和他的礼。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我心至诚，可对天地。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一躬到底，听凭尊意。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这不能保证对方一定首肯。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但你会甘心","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"height":0,"src":"//asset.sooon.ai/p/2022-06/25/bf5a7f7ed8e08b6196de63dec532d4b4.jpg","type":"image","version":1,"width":346}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这就是","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"礼","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"，记住了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}

article.title: 优质选择
article.question: 真正的优质男性应该是怎么样的？
article.brief:

article.text:
看了我的（或者我这类似的）答案会有所行动的。
所谓行动，包括尝试理解、整理和思考、参与友好讨论、默默传播和尝试实践。
你一般可以在我的评论区找到他们。
还有很多傻乎乎的不出声，你也许要凭运气碰了。
不分收入高低、人生阶段、职业方向、健康程度、家庭出身，只要是按照这些东西来对待人的，遇到了都是人的幸运。
将来你会明白的，所谓“优质”，其实就是这种幸运而已。
不是家财万贯、学富五车、仪表堂堂、孔武有力——那些只是对人好的潜力。
这些东西，是对人好本身。
他有一个亿又如何？给你这五块才是真的。
其实啊，有一个选择“情感信源”的简单措施。
理论、逻辑说起来有多通是次要的——既然是几万十几万关注的头部作者，要把这些说得你看不出哪里有错误当然总是能办到的。
看啥呢？
第一，看评论区里的男女比例是不是趋向均衡。
纯男或者纯女，那么从数据上就直接告诉你答案了。
第二，看评论区里有没有人在向往理论指向的理想异性。
这很现实。要是评论区里的主要关注群体高概率地招来异性痛骂……这不是直接出结果了么。
一个working的理论体系，应该直接使其实践者仅仅凭着认可这理论就得到目标服务用户的基本认可。
这不表示过了这关就万事大吉，肯定是有效真理。
但过不了这一关的一定不行。
这个道理其实非常朴素，但其实已经够你避开好多坑了。

article.title: 指天指地
article.question: 男人喜欢刀具很奇怪吗？
article.brief:
你削梨时刀尖是指天还是指地？



























你是不是从没想过这个问题？

































这个问题和你爱刀有什么关系？





























先说道理——
article.text:
你削梨时刀尖是指天还是指地？

你是不是从没想过这个问题？

这个问题和你爱刀有什么关系？

先说道理——
削水果会导致果汁流出。
如果你持刀姿势是刀柄低于刀刃，就会导致果汁和残渣流向刀柄。不但污染持刀手，使持刀不稳定，容易手滑出事故。更关键的是，粘稠的果汁往往含有强烈的酸性会腐蚀刀具的折叠结构和刀茎，而且还会发霉腐烂，破坏柄材，阻滞折叠机构。而破碎的植物组织也会掉入甚至卡入刀柄的缝隙里，更加恶化这些问题。
要想清理，至少也要大量流水冲洗，而这也一样容易导致生锈。
这个问题堪称折刀、带柄刀的绝症，是最常见的导致刀具报废的问题。
要避免这个问题，最简单的办法就是把接果皮的盘子从桌上挪到板凳上或者水槽底——于是刀尖会向下。

说明白了这一点，再说跟这问题有什么关系。
首先，你如果对这个问题感到惊讶，意味着两种可能：
要么，你虽然收藏刀具，但你从来不用；
要么，你使用刀具，但却并不在意基本的保养爱护。
前者爱的并不是刀，而是收藏和拥有这份收藏背后的身份感和价值感，刀只是因缘巧合所安排的具体题材，同一个人很可能还会收藏手表、宝石、邮票、字画。
后者爱的也不是刀，而是切、割、斩、剁的快感和这背后的安全感、控制感。
只有既拥有刀，又使用刀，并且还深切关心刀本身的安危的人，才是喜欢刀本身。
这个削水果的姿势是要观察和思考才会有的。并且还要练习和适应。这个姿势很显然也没有刀尖向上的下意识姿势舒服顺手。
实际上细节还不止这一点——注意到这个表达方式没有？
如果你持刀姿势是刀柄低于刀刃，就会导致果汁和残渣流向刀柄。不但污染持刀手，使持刀不稳定，容易手滑出事故。更关键的是，粘稠的果汁往往含有强烈的酸性会腐蚀刀具的折叠结构和刀茎，而且还会发霉腐烂，破坏柄材，阻滞折叠机构。而破碎的植物组织也会掉入甚至卡入刀柄的缝隙里，更加恶化这些问题。
这个递进关系，就是典型的爱刀人的思维方式。

而这三种情况，其实对应的是三个完全不同的问题，会有不同的答案。

人是非常复杂的存在，就像一个案子，是需要破的。
“观察”不是“看”，而是条分缕析、抽丝剥茧的分析。否则你不知道要看哪里，看了也看不见该看的东西。

而人一定要学会精确的观察自己，这样才不至于误会自己的感情和诉求。
这个习惯如何至关重要，举个最典型的例子——你是喜欢ta，还是喜欢ta的供养、还是喜欢ta的崇拜？
你是喜欢物理，还是喜欢物理高分带来的赞美？
分不清楚，你会犯下重大人生错误。
很多人一生的悲剧都发源于此。

而怎么观察你自己，这是一个很好的例子。

看看“刀尖”，指天，还是指地？

article.text:
其实呢，这背后有一个更深的隐藏主题，那就是美国去向何方的问题。
美国其实一直有一个名为“大政府小政府”之争的问题。但这个问题的实质远没有这么简单。
大政府，小政府，背后的根本问题是美国的国体之争。
众所周知，美国是一个联邦制国家，而中国是一个共和制国家。
联邦制和共和制到底是什么意思？
联邦制国家，联邦政府在原则上仅仅处理涉及各州间关系和各州对外的共同事务。
也就是原则上，除各州单独不能决定的、会影响到其他州和所有州共同利益的议题之外的议题，联邦政府不得插手甚至不能置喙。全部属于州权，由州内自决。
所以联邦政府只能管州际公路、邮政、军队、外交、美联储、NASA……这些事务。
除此之外的事务，联邦制的中央政府根本无权干涉。
而共和制是什么呢？是所有地方一起选举出中央政府，然后由中央政府统一管理整个国家的一切事务。
在共和制国家里也有地方政府，也会有地方法规，但是这些地方法规和联邦制政府体制下的州法、邦法是两回事，其合法性不是自在的，而是出自中央政府的认可和授权。
在共和制国家里，绝不存在一个地方政府决定后中央政府无权推翻的政策。即使存在所谓的自治区，看似中央政府不能那么直接的干预自治区政府的具体决策，但这些自治区的自治权本身也是由中央政府授予的，是可以取消和收回的。
美国的各州自己内部就全部是共和制，州法令就绝对高于下属郡县的法令。
你们看懂这个问题没有？
其实州权和联邦权的争夺，才是美国的最大、最根本的政治问题。
美国人民的心里，真正最大的敌人，不是中国，更不是俄罗斯，而是无时无刻不盘算着要巧立名目侵占州权的联邦政府——这个“必要之恶”。

南北战争的真正根源，实际上根本不是奴隶制问题，而是州有无权利自主脱离联邦的问题（如果有这个权利，那么美国的unite实际上是邦联，而非联邦）以及联邦政府有无权利干预州内部事务的问题。
这时候你就看得出一条主线了——美国存在着两股力量，一股力量在追求美国的共和化，而另一股力量在追求美国的邦联化。
这两者并没有将这两个至高纲领直接喊出来，在潜意识里，ta们会说自己只是想在现状基础上向两个不同的方向稍微修正。
但这其实客观上已经将这两条路线付诸了实现。
民主党总是在主张要用联邦法律确认某种新的共识。
而共和党用针锋相对的斗争，争取到的却并不是相反的立法——比如在这个堕胎问题上，共和党的胜利并非“联邦全面禁止堕胎”，而是“由各州自决”。
禁枪，斗争结果并非“全面不禁枪”，而是“各州自决”。
LGBTQ，“各州自决”。
气候保护，“各州自决”。
发现这规律了吗？
这个矛盾的具体机制是什么呢？
既然联邦制作为宪法宪法条款早已确立，难道堕胎问题、禁枪问题、同性恋问题……这些问题不是应该默认各州自决吗？
这就涉及到“共和派”——讽刺的是，他们反而自称民主党——的基本策略了。
那就是拿宪法作出发阵地，进攻州权的阵地。
宪法从基本原则上就属于毫无疑问绝对适用于全国的举国共识。
那么，从宪法条文出发可以得到的直接推论，也必然自动成为州权无权抗拒的举国共识。
因为它们是宪法逻辑不可分割的一部分。
譬如，宪法说人的自由必须得到保护，那么州法就绝不能搞出“杀人无罪”这种个性化条款。
这也是为什么“共和派”一旦发起宪法争议的案子，“联邦派”——这群反而主要是共和党——不能以“联邦管不着”为由来抵抗，而必须要想方设法证明“这跟宪法没有牢不可破的必然联系”。
而ta们斗争成功的结果，如前所述，也就并不会是反向的立法，而是“回到原貌”——或者不如说回到最初的理想——州权至大。
所以，其实共和党本质上并非拥枪派、反堕胎派、性保守派。
这些形象实际上是掌握媒体优势的民主党有意塑造的结果。
这也是为什么过去的美国史里共和党会长期居于战略下风的原因。
如果一直国泰民安、风调雨顺，美国的共和化——实质是美国的成熟化——是不可避免的自然过程。
但一旦美国失去了这个安然发育的历史条件，联邦化甚至邦联化的倾向就会重新活跃起来，把这个进程拉将回去。
其实你们仔细想想，如果美国完成了共和化，乃至于州政府退化成了类似中国的省政府一样的存在，美国可以调动的国力何止现在的水平？
一切现在看得到的美国的沉疴几乎全数迎刃而解。
但绝妙的是，它事实上的理想——中国——被它自己定义成了邪恶。
所以你们看到了美国现在这种一边怒斥中国补贴，一边自己纠结着要补贴;一边大骂计划经济，一边自己要搞大振兴；而无论要干什么，一半美国都要反对另一半美国这种神经错乱一般的症状。

一个鸡蛋把鸡视为恶魔。
How poetic is that？

rsion":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而共和党用针锋相对的斗争，争取到的却并不是相反的立法——比如在这个堕胎问题上，共和党的胜利并非“联邦全面禁止堕胎”，而是“由各州自决”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"禁枪，斗争结果并非“全面不禁枪”，而是“各州自决”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"LGBTQ，“各州自决”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"气候保护，“各州自决”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"发现这规律了吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这个矛盾的具体机制是什么呢？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"既然联邦制作为宪法宪法条款早已确立，难道堕胎问题、禁枪问题、同性恋问题……这些问题不是应该默认各州自决吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这就涉及到“共和派”——讽刺的是，他们反而自称民主党——的基本策略了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那就是拿宪法作出发阵地，进攻州权的阵地。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"宪法从基本原则上就属于毫无疑问绝对适用于全国的举国共识。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那么，从宪法条文出发可以得到的直接推论，也必然自动成为州权无权抗拒的举国共识。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为它们是宪法逻辑不可分割的一部分。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"譬如，宪法说人的自由必须得到保护，那么州法就绝不能搞出“杀人无罪”这种个性化条款。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这也是为什么“共和派”一旦发起宪法争议的案子，“联邦派”——这群反而主要是共和党——不能以“联邦管不着”为由来抵抗，而必须要想方设法证明“这跟宪法没有牢不可破的必然联系”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"而ta们斗争成功的结果，如前所述，也就并不会是反向的立法，而是“回到原貌”——或者不如说回到最初的理想——州权至大。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以，其实","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"共和党本质上并非拥枪派、反堕胎派、性保守派。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这些形象实际上是掌握媒体优势的民主党有意塑造的结果。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这也是为什么过去的美国史里共和党会长期居于战略下风的原因。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果一直国泰民安、风调雨顺，美国的共和化——实质是美国的成熟化——是不可避免的自然过程。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但一旦美国失去了这个安然发育的历史条件，联邦化甚至邦联化的倾向就会重新活跃起来，把这个进程拉将回去。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"其实你们仔细想想，如果美国完成了共和化，乃至于州政府退化成了类似中国的省政府一样的存在，美国可以调动的国力何止现在的水平？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一切现在看得到的美国的沉疴几乎全数迎刃而解。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但绝妙的是，它事实上的理想——中国——被它自己定义成了邪恶。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以你们看到了美国现在这种一边怒斥中国补贴，一边自己纠结着要补贴;一边大骂计划经济，一边自己要搞大振兴；而无论要干什么，一半美国都要反对另一半美国这种神经错乱一般的症状。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textSt article.text:
一次把质疑问题说透。
什么叫质疑？
疑不用说，质是什么？

质的古体其实是个会意字，上面两把斧头，下面一个贝壳。啥意思呢，给你两把斧头，你给我钱。
但是“质”和买卖有什么不同呢？
质这种做法是双向的。我给你斧头你给我钱，回头我再拿回钱来，你要把斧头还我。我若拿不出钱来，这斧头你可以一直拿着，但你不能搞丢，不能弄坏，不然我拿钱来时你没得还我了。
注意，质和现在的典当估计是不同的。典当是有利润的，是一种抵押放贷关系。你拿钱来赎斧头，比我当初给你的钱要多，不然我一开始不接你这单了。而这个在远古时期估计是不存在的。
一来，质最典型的运用其实是质子，质押、人质。看出问题了吗？我把我儿子放你这里，换你相信我会履行我们之间的合同。我合同履行完了，儿子你要完整的还我。你不能再把我儿子卖我一次再赚一笔钱。赚钱的部分在我们另外的合同里面，不在我儿子身上。
这就是质和典当的区别。
二来，这个字发明时人类还在用贝壳。这时候财富不是货币本位的，而是实物本位的。拿到斧头要比拿到贝壳重要。拿贝壳换到斧头你本身就赚了，回头人家拿贝壳来还斧头你还不长眼要加价，人家下回都不跟你玩了。实物本位时代有一个要害——交易双方往往是几百年的邻居，几百上千年里技术几乎毫无进步，需求和产出极其稳定，价格几乎是恒定的。
所以几乎没有“涨价”“利息”这一说。
五头羊换六袋米，换一百年都是五头羊换六袋米。我们村每年就多这五头羊，你们村每年就多这六袋米。你要加价你只管加，你就说你要不要吧，不要我牵走。
所谓“贝壳”“货币“，与其说是财富，不如说是一种简单的记账方式交割完毕即为废物。大家要的是羊和米，要贝壳干啥。
不过这扯远了，我们要讲的不是货币史，回到本题上。
本题要害在于——这是一种双向的交换关系，一种“绝对真等价”。
质的左右两边之物，就是任何时候可以绝对互换的东西。
换句话来说，“质”的最初含义，就是 “A=B” 中的“=”。
象形文化全是一群“引申”之王，这是天然本性决定的。朋是两串玉，友是两只手，美是一头羊，家是个猪圈。“质”这个字也不例外。
这个“中文等号”，很快就发生了进一步的引申——即从A=B的谓语“=”，迁移成了宾语“B”。
左边是个意象，右边也是一个意象，我们称后者为前者之“质”，即指“B即为A的理想等价物”——B是A的等价物，而且B比A更为完美，更接近真实、本源、简洁、实质。
换言之，质即物之真相。
是A去掉了矫饰的结果，是A的a。
所以我们在所有使用“质“字的地方，都可以用“真”、“实”、“使真实”来进行替换。
比如，
质量（物理）——实在的量，
质量（管理）——真实性的量度，
本质——本原的真相
实质——实在的真相
质押——使诚意为真的抵押（引申义与本意可互换）
质感——（使）真实感
质证——证实证据的真实性（使证据为实）。
这时候，我们就顺着这条线落到问题的核心了——质疑。
质疑是什么？
质为真且实，疑为惑而求。
这两者存在天然的矛盾。
质疑，是先确定了自己找到了实在的问题、找到了真确的破绽，然后通过“疑问”的形式要将自己找到的真实现实化、共识化。
这一系列的行为，无论是质疑、质询还是质问，都有一个共同前提，就是我自己已有上升到信念的定见，确知为真实和本原之断言，我现在来给你一系列问题，只是要借由这种形式引导你或者其他旁观者认知这一真理。
是为质疑。
质疑的前提，就是我已经确信我是对的，只是要办个手续来让你和旁人接受真理。
它事实上是一种（被企图的）教育（education）。
法庭上允许律师质疑证人，本质上是要求律师扮演教师的角色，尝试用自己认定的真相完成对法庭成员的教育。
老师可以质疑学生，因为本来就有教育的职权。
监护人可以质疑被监护人，因为监护关系本身就是基于意志的欠有效。
民意代表可以质询事务官员，因为人民意志的权威高于服务机构的意志，有权纠正后者的理解。
质问、质询、质疑，都有一个程序上的特点，都是不允许受动方反问。
法庭上律师质问证人，证人只能回答或者不回答，不能反问律师。律师没有回答义务。
民意代表质询官僚，官僚不能反问。民意代表没有义务回答。
可以回答，但不存在回答的义务，不回答的特权受到外部承认，是“保持教育的效率”的天然合理安排。
所以“质疑”才如此的令人陶醉。
因为质疑权就是上位的证明。
质疑者已经坐在了王座上。

但这也意味着——自授质疑权即为侵犯。
我如果是向你求教，即尊你为师，你就因为我的授权而有了质疑权。这时候我确定你说的就是对的，我只是要尽快搞个明白，所以要给你质疑权，方便你完成我的委托。
我如果是法庭受审——我通过入籍和不移民声明了我愿意接受这种方式来保护我的权利——那么我已经授权律师和检察官有单向发问尝试证明ta们观点的特权，以便让所有的案件都审得快点，减少我的税务负担。
你如果是我的被监护人，那么上帝——或曰命运——给了你授权，以降低全社会教育下一代的成本。上天有一切主权，我只能接受。
我如果是你的下属，要按照约定为你的目标提供服务，那么我已经授权给你在工作范围内质询我的理解和你的意图是否一致。
但是你有什么权利不经我允许，自行决定你所认定的真实一定比我所认定的真实为高、然后强行把我按在证人席上受你盘问，为你的case作人证？
如果是我进你家，你把条款写在大门口“凡进门的默认受审”也罢了。
现在是你冲进我家要审我。
你有没有这权利，你自己掂量一下。
你会受到对方的什么招待，是美酒还是霰弹，你思考思考。
你之所以不明白这个道理，是因为你的前半生，从老师到家长到训导主任到课代表到学生干部到追求对象到岳父母/公婆到警察到官员到老板到上司甚至到管居委会管物业看大门的，都获得了某种授权。
在你的客观世界里，似乎人人都天然的对你有质疑权。
你没有，似乎唯一的原因就是你还不是成人。
现在你是成人了——或者，借着互联网的遮蔽，别人无法确知你不是成人了——你应该自动获得了这个“人人都有的普遍权利”了吧，不是吗？
不是。
我完全理解你的心情，但答案仍然是NO。
Big Hard F*cking NO.
这话说得极其的硬，就是为了让你记牢一点，不要有任何侥幸。
坦率讲，这个错误是最容易导致你重大损失的致命误解，因为人类对这种“自授质疑权”的侵犯极端敏感，而且报复性极强。
眼都不眨把你简历丢垃圾桶，给你未来五年绩效都打C，“对不起我有喜欢的人了”这都算轻的——因为那还算是对方权利范围内的合法行为。
你只是错过了收益，但你其实没有遭受损失。（不捡钱算丢的人除外）
世上多的是一句“你瞅啥”，为“你知道这里不能抽烟吗”“你知道电影院不能大声说话吗”，拼着坐牢枪毙也要砍死你的。
看到抽烟，打市场监督电话。这你有权。叫店经理来要求按照服务条款提供服务，你有权。但是“你知道这里不能抽烟吗”，你无权。
龙哥进来吃饭的时候只同意了店主人觉得我不合规矩可以说我，可没有同意过全屋谁都可以觉得我不合规矩，谁都可以说我。
你要干，你就是村口打枪的鬼子，老子要跟你拼了。
“我是为了维护社会秩序”？鬼子也是来“推广民主”和“建立王道乐土”的。
乡亲们很质朴——你看这个质用得准不准——老子跟你拼了。
不容擅自质疑，这是“人的自由不容剥夺”的自然法。
这种冲动高于一切人间一切立法，根本不跟你商量，也不管你觉得合理不合理。
你把牛顿剁馅包饺子，你跳崖也会死。
聪明人视质疑人为龙潭虎穴。
别说没授权，就算是当事人斩鸡头烧黄纸割手指洒酒摔碗赌咒发誓保证“畅所欲言，绝不报复”，也别想老子上当。
这事就是赌命，你要给我赌命的理由，光赌咒发誓跟我保证这“不是赌博”，谁要上当？
除非我的质疑权合法到你反抗我可以叫出警察来或者因为某种原因我觉得这概率这样赌了我不后悔——比如先发我个万八千的，
否则白白的想要我质疑你，你想得美哦。

你们明白了吗？
质疑是把脑袋别在裤腰带上的活计，
拿它来寻求心理快感，和拿俄罗斯轮盘赌来娱乐没有本质区别。
扣动扳机的价码就是你的命价。
开一枪换两秒哈哈乐，值不值？

除非这可以换回谁的命，否则永远不值。

再说一遍——这规矩不是什么“邪恶父权集团”立的，所以质疑ta们没用。
立这规矩的，不受质疑。

问题来了，要是你实在心痒难熬，就是觉得你真的看到了问题，有个绝妙好槽，不吐就要死，怎么办呢？
那么你装也要装出你没有把握，用求证实、求解惑、求进一步说明的姿态提出来。
掐着自己大腿也要加上“我觉得”、“我猜想”、“个人感觉”、“似乎”、好像”这些不确定语气。
如果你是真诚的能养成这个自觉——就是真的不因为自己很肯定就断言是真理——那是最好，那表示你知礼。
你要知不了礼，那么你也要求礼貌。
没真家伙，你怎么着也要做出个样子。哪怕对方明知你是做个样子，对方狂暴发作的概率都会下降一个数量级，你都安全一大截。
还是俄罗斯轮盘赌——注意，不是没风险了——但起码换了个大转盘。

这不是“认怂”或者“作假”，而是懂得好歹，知道死活。
因为你“投降”和“认怂”的对象，不是你保持礼貌的这个人，而是“谁不努力守礼就发动人类灭了谁”的老天爷。
顺天者昌，逆天者亡，这里认怂不丢人。不认纯傻x，活该中达尔文奖。
当父母的，记住跟你家小崽子讲明白，保ta们一条小命。

{"root":{"children":[{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一次把质疑问题说透。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"什么叫质疑？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"疑不用说，质是什么？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"height":0,"src":"//asset.sooon.ai/p/2022-06/26/2cdd250e483dc6f338620849806e85c9.jpg","type":"image","version":1,"width":666}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质的古体其实是个会意字，上面两把斧头，下面一个贝壳。啥意思呢，给你两把斧头，你给我钱。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但是“质”和买卖有什么不同呢？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质这种做法是双向的。我给你斧头你给我钱，回头我再拿回钱来，你要把斧头还我。我若拿不出钱来，这斧头你可以一直拿着，但你不能搞丢，不能弄坏，不然我拿钱来时你没得还我了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"注意，质和现在的典当估计是不同的。典当是有利润的，是一种抵押放贷关系。你拿钱来赎斧头，比我当初给你的钱要多，不然我一开始不接你这单了。而这个在远古时期估计是不存在的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"一来，质最典型的运用其实是质子，质押、人质。看出问题了吗？我把我儿子放你这里，换你相信我会履行我们之间的合同。我合同履行完了，儿子你要完整的还我。你不能再把我儿子卖我一次再赚一笔钱。赚钱的部分在我们另外的合同里面，不在我儿子身上。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这就是质和典当的区别。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"二来，这个字发明时人类还在用贝壳。这时候财富不是货币本位的，而是实物本位的。拿到斧头要比拿到贝壳重要。拿贝壳换到斧头你本身就赚了，回头人家拿贝壳来还斧头你还不长眼要加价，人家下回都不跟你玩了。实物本位时代有一个要害——交易双方往往是几百年的邻居，几百上千年里技术几乎毫无进步，需求和产出极其稳定，价格几乎是恒定的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以几乎没有“涨价”“利息”这一说。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"五头羊换六袋米，换一百年都是五头羊换六袋米。我们村每年就多这五头羊，你们村每年就多这六袋米。你要加价你只管加，你就说你要不要吧，不要我牵走。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所谓“贝壳”“货币“，与其说是财富，不如说是一种简单的记账方式交割完毕即为废物。大家要的是羊和米，要贝壳干啥。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不过这扯远了，我们要讲的不是货币史，回到本题上。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"本题要害在于——这是一种","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"双向的交换关系，一种“绝对真等价”","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质的左右两边之物，就是任何时候可以绝对互换的东西。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"换句话来说，“质”的最初含义，就是 “A=B” 中的“=”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"象形文化全是一群“引申”之王，这是天然本性决定的。朋是两串玉，友是两只手，美是一头羊，家是个猪圈。“质”这个字也不例外。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这个“中文等号”，很快就发生了进一步的引申——即从A=B的谓语“=”，迁移成了宾语“B”。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"左边是个意象，右边也是一个意象，我们称后者为前者之“质”，即指“B即为A的理想等价物”——B是A的等价物，而且B比A更为完美，更接近真实、本源、简洁、实质。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"换言之，","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"即","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"物之真相","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是A去掉了矫饰的结果，是A的a。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以我们在所有使用“质“字的地方，都可以用“真”、“实”、“使真实”来进行替换。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"比如，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质量（物理）——实在的量，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质量（管理）——真实性的量度，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"本质——本原的真相","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"实质——实在的真相","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质押——使诚意为真的抵押（引申义与本意可互换）","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质感——（使）真实感","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质证——证实证据的真实性（使证据为实）。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这时候，我们就顺着这条线落到问题的核心了——","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑是什么？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质为真且实，疑为惑而求。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这两者存在天然的矛盾。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑，是先确定了自己找到了实在的问题、找到了真确的破绽，然后通过“疑问”的形式要将自己找到的真实现实化、共识化。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这一系列的行为，无论是质疑、质询还是质问，都有一个共同前提，就是我自己已有上升到信念的定见，确知为真实和本原之断言，我现在来给你一系列问题，只是要借由这种形式引导你或者其他旁观者认知这一真理。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"是为","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑的前提，就是我已经确信我是对的，只是要办个手续来让你和旁人接受真理。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"它事实上是一种（被企图的）教育（education）。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"法庭上允许律师质疑证人，本质上是要求律师扮演教师的角色，尝试用自己认定的真相完成对法庭成员的教育。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"老师可以质疑学生，因为本来就有教育的职权。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"监护人可以质疑被监护人，因为监护关系本身就是基于意志的欠有效。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"民意代表可以质询事务官员，因为人民意志的权威高于服务机构的意志，有权纠正后者的理解。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质问、质询、质疑，都有一个程序上的特点，都是","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不允许受动方反问","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"法庭上律师质问证人，证人只能回答或者不回答，不能反问律师。","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"律师没有回答义务。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"民意代表质询官僚，官僚不能反问。民意代表","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"没有义务回答","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"可以回答，但不存在回答的义务，不回答的特权受到外部承认，是“保持教育的效率”的天然合理安排。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"所以“质疑”才如此的令人陶醉。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑权就是上位的证明","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑者已经坐在了王座上。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但这也意味着——","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"自授质疑权即为侵犯。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我如果是向你求教，即尊你为师，你就因为我的授权而有了质疑权。这时候我确定你说的就是对的，我只是要尽快搞个明白，所以要给你质疑权，方便你完成我的委托。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我如果是法庭受审——我通过入籍和不移民声明了我愿意接受这种方式来保护我的权利——那么我已经授权律师和检察官有单向发问尝试证明ta们观点的特权，以便让所有的案件都审得快点，减少我的税务负担。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你如果是我的被监护人，那么上帝——或曰命运——给了你授权，以降低全社会教育下一代的成本。上天有一切主权，我只能接受。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我如果是你的下属，要按照约定为你的目标提供服务，那么我已经授权给你在工作范围内质询我的理解和你的意图是否一致。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"但是你有什么权利","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不经我允许","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"，自行决定你所认定的真实一定比我所认定的真实为高、然后强行把我按在证人席上受你盘问，为你的case作人证？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果是我进你家，你把条款写在大门口“凡进门的默认受审”也罢了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"现在是","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你冲进我家要审我。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你有没有这权利，你自己掂量一下。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你会受到对方的什么招待，是美酒还是霰弹，你思考思考。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你之所以不明白这个道理，是因为你的前半生，从老师到家长到训导主任到课代表到学生干部到追求对象到岳父母/公婆到警察到官员到老板到上司甚至到管居委会管物业看大门的，都获得了某种授权。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"在你的客观世界里，似乎人人都天然的对你有质疑权。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你没有，似乎唯一的原因就是你还不是成人。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"现在你是成人了——或者，借着互联网的遮蔽，别人无法确知你不是成人了——你应该自动获得了这个“人人都有的普遍权利”了吧，不是吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不是。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我完全理解你的心情，但答案仍然是NO。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"Big Hard F*cking NO.","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这话说得极其的硬，就是为了让你记牢一点，不要有任何侥幸。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"坦率讲，这个错误是最容易导致你重大损失的致命误解，因为人类对这种“自授质疑权”的侵犯极端敏感，而且","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"报复性极强","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"眼都不眨把你简历丢垃圾桶，给你未来五年绩效都打C，“对不起我有喜欢的人了”","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这都算轻的","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"——因为那还算是对方权利范围内的合法行为。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你只是错过了收益，但你","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"其实没有遭受损失","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。（不捡钱算丢的人除外）","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"世上多的是一句“你瞅啥”，为“你知道这里不能抽烟吗”“你知道电影院不能大声说话吗”，","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"拼着坐牢枪毙也要砍死你的","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"看到抽烟，打市场监督电话。这你有权。叫店经理来要求按照服务条款提供服务，你有权。但是“你知道这里不能抽烟吗”，你","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"无权","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"龙哥进来吃饭的时候只同意了店主人觉得我不合规矩可以说我，可没有同意过全屋谁都可以觉得我不合规矩，谁都可以说我。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你要干，你就是村口打枪的鬼子，老子要跟你拼了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"“我是为了维护社会秩序”？鬼子也是来“推广民主”和“建立王道乐土”的。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"乡亲们很质朴——你看这个质用得准不准——老子跟你拼了。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不容擅自质疑，这是“人的自由不容剥夺”的","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"自然法","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这种冲动高于一切人间一切立法，根本不跟你商量，也不管你觉得合理不合理。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你把牛顿剁馅包饺子，你跳崖也会死。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"聪明人视质疑人为龙潭虎穴。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"别说没授权，就算是当事人斩鸡头烧黄纸割手指洒酒摔碗赌咒发誓保证“畅所欲言，绝不报复”，也别想老子上当。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这事就是赌命，你要给我赌命的理由，光赌咒发誓跟我保证这“不是赌博”，谁要上当？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"除非","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"我的质疑权合法到你反抗我可以叫出警察来","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"或者因为某种原因我觉得这概率这样赌了我不后悔——比如先发我个万八千的，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"否则白白的想要我质疑你，","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你想得美哦","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你们明白了吗？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质疑是把脑袋别在裤腰带上的活计，","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"拿它来寻求心理快感，和拿俄罗斯轮盘赌来娱乐没有本","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"质","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"区别。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"扣动扳机的价码就是你的命价。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"开一枪换两秒哈哈乐，值不值？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"除非这可以换回谁的命，否则","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"永远不值","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"再说一遍——这规矩不是什么“邪恶父权集团”立的，所以质疑ta们没用。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"立这规矩的，不受质疑。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"问题来了，要是你实在心痒难熬，就是觉得你真的看到了问题，有个绝妙好槽，不吐就要死，怎么办呢？","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"那么你装也要装出你没有把握，用求证实、求解惑、求进一步说明的姿态提出来。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"掐着自己大腿也要加上“我","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"觉得","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"”、“我","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"猜想","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"”、“个人感觉”、“似乎”、好像”这些不确定语气。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"如果你是真诚的能养成这个自觉——就是真的不因为自己很肯定就断言是真理——那是最好，那表示你知礼。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"你要知不了礼，那么你也要求","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"礼貌","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"没真家伙，你","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"怎么着也要做出个样子","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。哪怕对方明知你是做个样子，对方狂暴发作的概率都会下降一个数量级，你都安全一大截。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"还是俄罗斯轮盘赌——注意，不是没风险了——但起码换了个大转盘","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"这不是“认怂”或者“作假”，而是","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"懂得好歹","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"，","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"知道死活","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"因为你“投降”和“认怂”的对象，","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":1,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"不是你保持礼貌的这个人","type":"text","version":1},{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"，而是“谁不努力守礼就发动人类灭了谁”的老天爷。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"顺天者昌，逆天者亡，这里认怂不丢人。不认纯傻x，活该中达尔文奖。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""},{"type":"horizontalrule","version":1},{"children":[{"detail":0,"format":0,"mode":"normal","style":"","text":"当父母的，记住跟你家小崽子讲明白，保ta们一条小命。","type":"text","version":1}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"paragraph","version":1,"textFormat":0,"textStyle":""}],"direction":null,"format":"","indent":0,"type":"root","version":1}}
